Retained deposited heavy atoms only; minimum distance is descriptive geometry, not binding energy, affinity, hydrogen-bond proof, selectivity or causality. Missing/zero-
occupancy atoms are not imputed, so values cannot exclude closer absent atoms. Coordinate uncertainty is not propagated. The four crystal sites are not independent samples;
NUDT5 and NUDT14 residue axes are target-specific and are not homology-aligned.
